name: All-Terrain Vehicle
description: Any motor vehicle used for recreational off-road use, which takes in an off-road electric dirt bike as well as a quad.

restrictions.rule: Any motor vehicle used for recreational off-road use, with no limit on wheels, power or speed (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.010(24))

Kept off public highways and their rights-of-way, except to cross a two-lane highway at close to a right angle and within two-tenths of a mile, or on roads a state, city or county government designates (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.515)
Ridden on public property only where the agency responsible for it allows, and on private property only with the owner's or tenant's consent (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.515)
Riders 16 and older must wear an approved helmet on public property (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.515)
Riders and passengers under 16 must wear an approved helmet, and may ride only under direct parental supervision (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.515)
Children under 6 may not operate one (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.515)
A rider under 16, or one without a permit or license, may not carry a passenger (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.515)
Riding on a designated or crossing highway needs a valid operator's license, a headlight and two taillights, and daylight (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.515)
